WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_analysed_transactions
FROM per_type;

assumptions.assumption: Trader types with no qualifying analysed transactions are omitted because the query groups qualifying analyses.
